# CrossbarArrayIntegration

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The arrangement of memory devices in a grid of wordlines and bitlines to perform vector-matrix multiplications in the analog domain. Forms the core physical substrate for both TCC and iNEST, enabling high-throughput, low-power computation and memory co-location.
